records.name: T1-turnaround.attempt1
records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production T1 DAO TU Storm Reaver TURNAROUND from exact attached canonical front master. Five equally spaced full-body views LEFT TO RIGHT E (strict profile looking screen right), SE (front three-quarter looking down-right), S (exact front looking viewer, copy reference face), NE (rear three-quarter looking up-right), N (back directly away). All same man, same scale, same crown and sole rows across five views. Preserve face/grey eyes/swept fringe/low loose black ponytail and T1 plain sleeveless dark muted teal tunic, storm grey-blue collar and sash, short split overskirt, loose dark trousers, dark boots/bracers minimal dull brass. Same heavy broad single-edge dao on RIGHT shoulder with sparse ink mountain blade, plain guard; rotate weapon naturally with character. Strict semi-chibi 4.5heads: crown-to-chin22% anatomical H, eyes16% below crown. No enlarged child head, no realistic small head. Keep anatomical shoulders lean. Use consistent game isometric elevated camera (slightly see boot tops) for all five; E silhouette profile, SE both eyes, NE rear cheek only, N no face. No body shrink to fit weapon. Entire bodies, ponytails and entire blades fit each equal-width panel with margin; do not overlap. Opaque uniform pure RGB255,0,255 MAGENTA background. NO lines/text/labels/borders/shadows/FX, no mantle, no gold embroidery, no new gear. Wide horizontal five-view character model sheet at large native resolution. Face lock is critical.

Each figure has crown-to-sole height roughly660px but heads are too small at110-130px. Pure opaque RGB255,0,255 magenta background, no text, shadows or FX. All five heads need proportional enlargement, not just face.
